escalation_condition: Continuous arterial spurting, pooling blood, lightheadedness, or bleeding unchecked after 3 minutes
source: Red Cross & AHA First Aid Guidelines for Hemorrhage Control
approved_actions: Apply continuous, firm direct pressure directly over the wound with a clean cloth or sterile gauze.
Do not remove the cloth if it soaks through; stack more layers on top and press harder.
Help the patient sit or lie down flat immediately to prevent fainting or injury.
Keep the injured person warm with a blanket or jacket.
Do not apply an improvised tourniquet unless trained and blood is actively spurting.
critical_actions: Maintain relentless direct pressure without lifting the cloth to check the wound.
contraindications: Never remove embedded objects or knives; stabilize them in place.
Never administer aspirin or blood thinners.
